title: Annual currency adjustments to Microsoft Commercial Cloud pricing
summary: The post Annual currency adjustments to Microsoft Commercial Cloud pricing appeared first on Source .
body_markdown:
Effective January 1, 2027, Microsoft will update its commercial cloud pricing in select currencies as part of its annual review of local currency pricing. This reflects the transition, announced in July of this year, to an annual process for local currency adjustments, set each January. These changes will align local currency pricing with global levels and apply to the Australian Dollar (AUD), Chinese Yuan (CNY), Indian Rupee (INR), Norwegian Krone (NOK), and New Zealand Dollar (NZD).


**Pricing Currency** **Cloud % Adjustment** 1 **On-Prem % Adjustment**


Australian Dollar (AUD) -4% None


Chinese Yuan (CNY)2 Up to -8.5% None


Indian Rupee (INR) +15.7% Up to +20%


Norwegian Krone (NOK) -5.9% None


New Zealand Dollar (NZD) +10% +10%


*1Percentage changes for individual SKUs might vary slightly from these percentages due to pricing calculations and rounding rules. 2For Chinese Yuan (CNY), the changes apply to Microsoft’s global cloud services and Microsoft Cloud operated by 21Vianet (excluding Microsoft Azure operated by 21Vianet).*


These updates are designed to ensure customers around the world can access, build on, and innovate with the latest Microsoft cloud products at competitive and regionally consistent prices. They also reflect our continued investment in technologies that help customers innovate, reduce operational costs, improve performance and efficiency, and strengthen security.


Pricing in Brazilian Real (BRL) will be reviewed following the implementation of Brazil’s tax reform, and any updates will be communicated in advance. Separately, Japanese Yen (JPY) pricing adjustments will remain on an annual April cadence with details for April 2027 to be shared in February 2027.
